verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs explicitly list 'Reader SDKs' as one of three official ways to integrate in-person payments and state you can 'Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app' (sumup-docs-5, sumup-docs-21, sumup-docs-29), confirming an official mobile SDK path exists. However, the evidence pack has no SDK reference docs, code samples, package names, or install instructions for the iOS/Android SDKs themselves (only a JS/web SDK snippet and Cloud API HTTPS calls are detailed), and no independent developer confirmation of using the mobile SDK directly. Missing for 10: iOS/Android SDK API reference or code samples, package/distribution details (CocoaPods/Gradle), and third-party corroboration of native SDK usage.
